subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff / vendor master corrections — Acme Supplies
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Acme Supplies (vendor master updates)

Hi Peter,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. Before we schedule the formal kickoff call, a couple of housekeeping items popped up in our vendor master that we want to resolve so PO creation and first payment aren't delayed: 

- Company address variants: our system shows two supplier records for Acme Supplies (one with the old HQ address on 5th St, one with the new address on Harbor Ave).
- Banking info: we received a bank details update PDF from your accounts team but need it entered into our Banking Update Template and verified via an independent confirmation (ACH micro-deposit or banking letter).
- Tax ID: the EIN on file doesn't match the W-9 you uploaded to the portal.

Can you confirm the correct legal name and single mailing address we should use for POs, and re-send the banking confirmation to accounts@acme-supplies.com (Cc'd) with the subject line "Redwood - Bank Confirmation for Vendor Master"?

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and a blank Banking_Update_Template.xlsx to make this easier. Once we have the corrected address and one verified bank record, our Vendor Data team will de-duplicate the old record and perform the master data change.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You confirm legal name + primary remit address (reply to all) — due EOD 2026-03-01
2) Your AP team returns the Banking_Update_Template completed and confirms verification method — due 2026-03-02
3) We schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk through PO process, invoicing cadence, and SLAs — pick times 2026-03-03 or 2026-03-04

If any of this is sensitive, we can move the banking exchange to DocuSign or provide an SFTP drop.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf), Banking_Update_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@acme-supplies.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2026-03-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Acme Supplies (vendor master updates)

On Sat, Feb 28, 2026 at 9:15 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Peter,
> 
> Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. Before we schedule the formal kickoff call, a couple of housekeeping items popped up in our vendor master that we want to resolve so PO creation and first payment aren't delayed: 
> 
> - Company address variants: our system shows two supplier records for Acme Supplies (one with the old HQ address on 5th St, one with the new address on Harbor Ave).
> - Banking info: we received a bank details update PDF from your accounts team but need it entered into our Banking Update Template and verified via an independent confirmation (ACH micro-deposit or banking letter).
> - Tax ID: the EIN on file doesn't match the W-9 you uploaded to the portal.

Hi Monica — thanks for the clear summary. Apologies for the confusion: we moved offices late last year and IT should have updated the vendor portal. Quick answers below: 

- Legal name: Acme Supplies Ltd. (please remove trailing punctuation variants if any)
- Correct remit address (primary): 220 Harbor Avenue, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401
- W-9: I'll have our tax lead re-upload an updated W-9 to the portal this morning.
- Banking: AP will complete the Banking_Update_Template and can do micro-deposits for verification. They will also send a completed template to accounts@acme-supplies.com (that's our AP alias).

We should be able to meet on 2026-03-03 at 11:00 PT for the kickoff. If that works for your team, please send an invite.

Regards,
Peter Lowe
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Supplies Ltd

Attachment: copy of bank_update_from_acme.pdf (application/pdf)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@acme-supplies.com>, accounts@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2026-03-01T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Acme Supplies (vendor master updates)

Monica / Marissa — quick operational note from Vendor Data: 

I will handle the duplicate-record cleanup once we have these confirmations. Our steps: 
- Validate legal name + remit address against the submitted W-9 and public records.
- Run a dedupe job to merge the older "Acme Supplies" record (Vendor ID V-00421) into the primary (Vendor ID V-01893).
- Archive the old vendor number and keep a cross-reference in the vendor history field so existing POs/invoices map correctly.
- For banking: we require either (a) two successful micro-deposits from Acme's bank to our verification account, or (b) a bank letter on letterhead plus the filled Banking_Update_Template.

A couple of follow-ups I will need from Acme AP during or immediately after the kickoff: 
- Confirm whether the micro-deposits will be sent (and expected timing)
- Provide the bank routing + account last 4 digits in the template (we will not store full account numbers in plaintext in the master)

Marissa — once David marks the de-dup as complete, can finance confirm the vendor mapping in Netsuite (or the current ERP) so we can push an initial PO?

Thanks,
David Kim
Vendor Data Lead
Redwood Inference

(Forwarded: Banking_Update_Template.xlsx attached for Acme AP)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, accounts@acme-supplies.com
Date: 2026-03-02T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Acme Supplies (vendor master updates)

Thanks everyone — summary and confirmed next steps: 

- Peter: confirmed legal name and primary address (220 Harbor Avenue, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401). Thank you for re-uploading the W-9.
- Acme AP (accounts@acme-supplies.com): please complete the Banking_Update_Template.xlsx and confirm whether you'll do micro-deposits or provide a bank letter. If micro-deposits, let us know expected date so David can watch for them.
- David: please proceed with the dedupe and keep a short audit note of the original vendor IDs. Flag any PO mapping issues to Marissa immediately.

I've scheduled the 30-min kickoff for 2026-03-03 11:00 PT and sent a calendar invite to all. Meeting agenda: 1) PO flow and turnaround, 2) invoice submission & remittance, 3) payment terms and SLA, 4) outstanding data items and timeline to first payment.

If anyone needs the invite moved, reply-all with alternative times.

Best,

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
